## Phase5 implementation candidate — developer SDK/CI complete; independent G2 pending

There is no broker transport, deployment or financial approval.

The user explicitly accepted C-P5-001 and P5-D01–D10 and separately authorized implementation. See `docs/audits/phase-5/IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZATION.json`. G1's four findings are **CLOSED_DESIGN**, not implementation findings closed by an independent G2. This new full SHA has not yet received independent GPT Work G2 or phase acceptance.

## Main implementation points

- Outer events only; actual portfolio40 / risk50 / submission60 / control65 / serial Match70 with Fill80+Account90 local children. Each candidate uses latest state and full actual/P4 budget risk checks.
- Immutable prepared/committed transactions, exact hashes, deterministic committed-prefix comparison, original-run recovery, idempotence and retained pre/post-crash evidence.
- Strictly future legal opening slices; fixed bidirectional price bands, limit protection, tick/slippage, minimum per-Fill commission and cumulative worst-case remaining fee budget.
- Shared opening capacity max10, historical ADV with frozen request parameters, actual publication/revision selection and P1 volume-byte binding. Future daily volume and late opening slices cannot backfill a trade.
- Disjoint settled/unsettled/short buckets, no duplicate short-proceeds freeze; T+1, average-cost ledger, exact FIFO historical costs, split/dividend/pay/borrow/recovery/stale/margin rules.
- Exact wide financial output, lossless original-P4 input encoding, explicit refusal for nonrepresentable projections; actual serialized/persisted/returned-byte checks and terminal source roles.
- Flow-adjusted TWR, A252/ddof1/rf0, explicit undefined statistics, FIFO fragment and long/short contribution reconciliation. Fees/slippage are not deducted twice.
